description: This Java source file defines an enumeration for well-known exported and internal HTTP header definitions used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes header keys, types, and validation logic for each header.

classes.name: DittoHeaderDefinition
classes.description: An enumeration representing various well-known Ditto headers with their key, type, and validation.

methods.name: forKey
methods.description: Looks up a header definition for a given key, returning an optional HeaderDefinition.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the header key as a string.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type associated with this header.

methods.name: getSerializationType
methods.description: Returns the type used for serialization of this header's value.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether this header should be read from external headers.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether this header should be written to external headers.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates a given header value using the specified validator.
